title: Character Class
description: Defines a character class with comprehensive narrative integration, LLM-GM guidance, and enhanced progression mechanics.

name.description: The display name of the class.

era.description: The primary era this class is most associated with, e.g., 'Galactic_Republic', 'Galactic_Empire', 'New_Republic'.

rarity.description: How common this class is in the galaxy.

narrative.description: Rich narrative description of the class, their role, and significance in the galaxy. Used by LLM-GM for storytelling.

flavor_text.description: Iconic quote or description that captures the essence of this class, often from Star Wars lore.

cultural_significance.description: Description of how this class is viewed and valued by different cultures and groups in the galaxy.

description.description: Detailed mechanical and lore description of the class.

origin_story.description: The history and origin of this class in the galaxy.

hit_die.description: The type of hit die this class uses (e.g., 'd8', 'd10', 'd12').

primary_ability.description: The primary ability score for this class.

class_identity_profile.description: Narrative flavor elements that define the class's identity and role in the galaxy.

core_fantasy.description: The core fantasy this class fulfills for players.

key_attributes.description: The key attributes and characteristics of this class.

iconic_gear.description: Iconic equipment and weapons associated with this class.

role_in_galaxy.description: The role this class plays in the broader galaxy.

famous_exemplars.description: Famous examples of this class from Star Wars lore.

species_synergies.description: Detailed species synergies with narrative descriptions.

narrative.description: Why this species has synergy with this class

faction_synergies.description: Detailed faction synergies with narrative descriptions.

narrative.description: Why this faction has synergy with this class

level_progression.description: Progression features granted at each level from 1-20.

level.description: The level at which this feature is granted.

feature_id.description: ID of the feature being granted.

feature_type.description: The type of feature being granted.

choices.description: Available choices for this feature (if applicable).

tags.description: UNIVERSAL TAGGING SYSTEM (Genesis Protocol Article II): Static tags that define this class' fundamental characteristics and role. All tags must be defined in master_tags.yml. Examples: ['force_user', 'tank', 'melee_specialist'].

properties.$comment: MIGRATION NOTE: The 'connections' block is DEPRECATED per Genesis Protocol Article III. Migrate to synergy_rules.yml using tags.

connections.description: DEPRECATED: Use tags and synergy_rules.yml instead. Universal connections to any game object - factions, species, locations, etc.

target_id.description: ID of the target object (faction, species, location, etc.).

target_type.description: The type of object being connected to.

relationship.description: The nature of the relationship, e.g., 'Common Among', 'Restricted To', 'Iconic To'.

narrative.description: Description of how these objects are connected.

mechanical_benefit.description: Optional mechanical benefit from this connection.

roleplay_guidance.description: Guidance for roleplaying characters of this class.

narrative_hooks.description: Story hooks and narrative elements specific to this class.

social_dynamics.description: How this class interacts with others in the galaxy.

common_motivations.description: Common motivations and goals for characters of this class.

base_prompt.description: Base prompt for generating images of this class.

contextual_modifiers.description: Modifiers for different contexts and situations.

target_type.description: The type of image being generated (e.g., 'Portrait', 'Action_Shot', 'Class_Scene').

modifier_text.description: Additional text to add to the prompt for this context.

image.description: Path to the class image file.

icon.description: Path to the class icon file.

color.description: Primary color associated with this class for UI theming.
